title: [Kev 2] crates/kev: request models, renderer, delimiter sanitize
body:
Part of #9337.

## What to pull over

From `kev/api.py` (pydantic shapes) and `kev/model.py:user_tokens`:

- `SystemOneRequest`: `state` (string|object|array), `model`, `questions` map; `Noul`/`Choice`/`Score` question types with the TypeSafe criteria shapes and 255-option bound.
- `render()`: structured values → labelled text, identical to the Python renderer (train and serve share one renderer).
- `option_text()`, `to_record()`: questions → `{instr, options}` records plus per-question metadata (keys, legends).
- `user_tokens()`: the `<|name|>` → `<¦name¦>` rewrite that makes delimiters unforgeable.
- Answer types matching `crates/jev`'s `answers.rs` shapes so the wire contract is identical: `noul`, `choice`+probabilities+confidence, `score`+legend+probabilities+confidence.

## Acceptance

- New `crates/kev` workspace member; `cargo test -p kev` renders every corpus request to text identical to the Python reference (fixtures from the Kev-1 issue).
- Validation refusals typed: >255 options, missing criteria, empty questions.
